subject: prd/argus
statement: When a stage question is underdetermined by the problem ledger plus governing documents, Argus shall rule by assumption recorded at the load-bearing spot with attribution.
rationale: assumption-first is what "figure it out" means (brainstorm:autonomous-developer#D-4, #D-6)
fit_criterion: audited against the drive-session transcript and an artifact-derivation sweep: every judgment not determined by the problem ledger + governing documents appears as a recorded, attributed ruling — the denominator is independent of the assumptions list
